```c title="C"

#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "xberg.h"

int main(void) {
    uintptr_t result = xberg_pdf_page_count("pdf/sample_contract.pdf", NULL);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
